iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

RADIUS::rtdom
       RADIUS::rtdom

SYNOPSIS
       RADIUS::rtdom (ROUTE_DOMAIN)?

DESCRIPTION
       This command overwrites the default route-domain ID in RADIUS scenario with given value

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
	when CLIENT_ACCEPTED {
	    if { [RADIUS::code] == 4 } {
		set rd 0
		# Extract the APN information from the AVP
		set called_station_id [RADIUS::avp 30 "string"]
		if {$called_station_id == "station1"} {
		    set rd 1
		} elseif {$called_station_id == "station2"} {
		    set rd 2
		}
		# Overwrite the default route domain value with the new value.
		RADIUS::rtdom $rd
	    }
	}

HINTS
       CLIENT_ACCEPTED CLIENT_CLOSED CLIENT_DATA SERVER_CLOSED SERVER_CONNECTED SERVER_DATA

SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-10.1.0
	   --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
